# Fiona Tang Studio

> Fiona Tang Studio is a photography studio based in Nice, France, run by photographer Fiona Tang. It photographs travel portraits, couples, proposals, elopements and weddings in Nice and along the French Riviera (Èze, Monaco and nearby). The website is available in Chinese, English, French and German.

> Fiona Tang Studio 是常驻法国尼斯的摄影工作室，摄影师为 Fiona Tang，拍摄南法个人旅拍、情侣写真、求婚、私奔与婚礼，服务尼斯及蔚蓝海岸（埃兹、摩纳哥等）。网站提供中文、英文、法文、德文四个版本，可用中文沟通。

## Facts

- Name: Fiona Tang Studio
- Photographer: Fiona Tang
- Based in: Nice, France
- Service area: Nice and the French Riviera; Provence and other French cities on request
- Starting prices: travel portraits from €299; couple, proposal and small ceremony sessions from €399
- Website: https://www.fionatangstudio.com/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/fiona.tang.riviera/
- RedNote / 小红书: https://www.rednote.com/user/profile/5e3f77730000000001007f0d
- Email: fionatanggg@gmail.com
